headline: JSA, TT&A, Baker & McKenzie advise brokers on Mylan Inc's ₹3,679 crore exit from Biocon
sum: Mylan Inc. has divested its entire stake of upto 5.64% in Biocon Limited on the screen-based trading platform of the BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India for ₹3,679 crore, making a complete exit.
detail: Mylan Inc. has divested its entire stake of upto 5.64% in Biocon Limited on the screen-based trading platform of the BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India for ₹3,679 crore, making a complete exit. JSA Advocates & Solicitors has advised Jefferies India, one of the brokers on this stake sale. The transaction was led by Arka Mookerjee (Partner), with support from Pracheta Bhattacharya (Partner) and Arjun Rastogi (Principal Associate).
